Text: Stripe is reportedly acquiring OpenRouter for over $7 billion.

82 days ago, OpenRouter raised its Series B at $1.3 billion. That's a 5x markup in under 3 months.

The company was founded in 2023. Went from $10M annualized revenue in late 2024 to over $100M by mid-2025. 8 million developers. 400+ AI models through one API.

Its founder once called it "the Stripe of AI." Now Stripe is actually buying it.
